Name: The Covenant of the Ensouled Arms - Many Blades
Author: duijiangyaoyue
Description:
The Covenant of the Ensouled Arms - Many Blades is a Galgame-style weapon and spirit bonding mod for Stardew Valley 1.6. It is built around a simple idea: an ensouled weapon should be more than a damage number. It should have a voice, a temperament, a past it is still trying to understand, and a reason to grow alongside the farmer who carries it.

The mod begins with Silverfrost, the first ensouled arm, but it is designed as a series rather than a single-weapon project. Silverfrost is the starting point; the framework of bonds, daily conversations, weapon growth, skill books, and quiet moments in the mines is meant to support more ensouled arms in the future. Each arm can have its own spirit, its own rhythm, and its own way of speaking.

At the heart of the mod is a Galgame-style bond line. You talk with Frost, choose replies, and gradually learn how she thinks. The bond moves through five stages, and each stage opens new daily conversations. There are eighty daily scenes for Frost, each with three choices and a distinct reply, arranged so that the relationship develops rather than repeats. The first complete conversation of each day settles bond; further talks that day rotate text without adding more bond. The choices shape the tone of the relationship through a light personality axis, but they do not lock you out of content or punish a preference.

Alongside the bond line is the mine-growth line. Silverfrost evolves through five forms as you reach deeper floors: Broken Edge, Honed Edge, Frost Pattern, Silver Tide, and Final Vow. Each form changes the blade's damage, speed, critical chance, knockback, level cap, and sword-momentum cap. Kills with the weapon grant experience; levels add damage; deeper mines push the weapon into its next form. The two lines are independent: you can focus on conversation, on mining, or on both at your own pace.

Fifteen equipable skills give the blade a combat identity beyond raw stats. Five passives, five active skills, and five awakenings are unlocked through skill books found in the mines, awarded by evolution, or recovered from the starter chest. Skills are equipped freely, so a build can be adjusted without losing progress. Sword momentum is the shared resource for active skills and awakenings, and it can be restored by fighting, mining, descending deeper, or simply carrying the blade.

If Cloudcutter is installed, the Cloudcutter spirit can join the story. The two sister swords share a one-time crossover: one entry begins with Frost, the other with the Cloudcutter spirit, and the first one seen in a save locks the other. The crossover keeps a single active portrait per page, closing and reopening the dialogue when the speaker changes. It also adds dual-wield bonuses and a dual-spirit assist, giving both blades a reason to travel together.

The tone is quiet rather than melodramatic. Much of the mod is about small things: a sword being cleaned, a cup of tea, a difficult question answered honestly, or a spirit learning to trust the person who keeps showing up. The writing aims to let the relationship breathe while the weapon grows stronger.

The Covenant of the Ensouled Arms - Many Blades requires Stardew Valley 1.6.15 and SMAPI 4.5.2 or newer. Cloudcutter is optional and only needed for the Cloudcutter spirit and the crossover. Generic Mod Config Menu is optional but recommended for adjusting keys and parameters in-game.

《灵兵契-万刃物语》是一款以「灵兵」为核心的 Galgame 式星露谷模组。这里的灵兵不是一件只写着伤害数字的武器，而是有声音、有脾气、有记忆、也有未说出口的心事。当前版本从第一把灵兵「银霜」开始，但整个框架并不是为单把剑准备的：羁绊、日常、矿洞成长、技能书与那些安静的片刻，都是为后续更多灵兵留出的位置。每一把灵兵都可以有自己的剑灵、自己的节奏、自己的说话方式。

模组的核心是一条 Galgame 式羁绊线。你与霜交谈、做选择，慢慢理解她为什么这样看人、这样握剑。羁绊分为五个阶段，每个阶段都会开放新的日常对话。霜目前有 80 份日常，每份有 3 个选项与各自不同的回应；文本按关系推进排列，而不是只换一句寒暄。每天第一次完整交谈结算羁绊，之后仍可继续聊，只轮换文本，不再增加羁绊。选项会轻微改变性格轴与说话口吻，但不会锁死内容，也不会因为一次选择就惩罚你。

与羁绊并行的，是矿洞成长线。随着你抵达更深的层数，银霜会依次进入五个阶段：残锋、磨锋、霜纹、银潮、终誓。每次成长都会改变伤害、速度、暴击、击退、等级上限与剑势上限。手持银霜击杀怪物会获得经验，升级会提高伤害，越深的矿洞会把它推向下一形态。两条线互不前置：你可以专心交谈，也可以专心下矿，或者按自己的节奏同时推进。

15 个可装配技能让银霜不只是数值更高的剑。5 个被动、5 个主动、5 个觉醒，通过矿洞技能书、阶段进化或初始宝箱解锁。技能可以自由换装，不需要重开存档来试 build。剑势是主动技能与觉醒共用的资源，可以通过战斗、挖矿、下矿与携带武器自然恢复。

安装裁云后，裁云剑灵也会加入故事。两把姊妹剑共享一次联动：一个入口从霜开始，另一个入口从裁云剑灵开始；同一个存档中先看到哪一边，就会锁住另一边。联动每页只显示当前说话人的立绘，换人时先收起对话框再重新拉起。双持与双武器协战则让两把剑有一起上路的理由。

整体语气偏安静，而不是大起大落。很多内容只是小事：擦一把剑、喝一杯茶、认真回答一个不好回答的问题，或者让一个剑灵慢慢相信那个总会回来的人。写作希望让关系有呼吸的空间，也让武器在变强的同时，仍然像一个有自己想法的人。

运行需要星露谷 1.6.15 与 SMAPI 4.5.2 或更新版本。裁云是可选的，只影响裁云剑灵与联动；Generic Mod Config Menu 也是可选的，但推荐用于调整键位与参数。
